name: sap-notes
description: Search and read SAP Notes / KBAs from me.sap.com using your own S-user.
long_description: MCP server for searching and retrieving SAP Notes with full content and metadata (validity, support packages, corrections). Fork of marianfoo/sap-mcp-servers with self-healing re-authentication on expired sessions and automatic one-time Chromium download on first run (~170 MB). Requires an SAP S-user with access to me.sap.com.

sap_username.title: SAP S-User (email)
sap_username.description: Your SAP Support Portal login, e.g. S0001234567 or your work e-mail linked to it.

sap_password.title: SAP Password
sap_password.description: Password for the S-user above. Stored in Claude Desktop settings.
